newsitem.title: USA: Clark Refining buys 51 Hop-In retail stores.
newsitem.headline: Clark Refining buys 51 Hop-In retail stores.

text.p: Clark Refining & Marketing Inc said on Monday it has bought 51 Hop-In gasoline and convenience stores and related fuel distribution business from Silcorp Ltd.
The acquisition will increase the number of Clark retail outlets to more than 870 in the Midwest, with more than 200 locations in Michigan alone, the company said.
Earlier on Monday, Silcorp Ltd said it sold the 51 outlets to Clark Refining for gross proceeds of $21.3 million (U.S.).

Silcorp said the transaction is subject to further due diligence by Clark for a period of seven days. It also said both parties intend to finish negotiation of definitive documentation by Dec 16, 1996, and close on Jan 2, 1997.
Clark Refining refines and markets petroleum products and operates convenience outlets in the United States.

Clark Refining is a wholly owned subsidiary of Clark USA, Inc, which is 46-percent owned by TrizecHahn Corp, 31 percent owned by a Tiger Management of New York, 19-percent owned by Occidental Petroleum, and four-percent owned by Gulf Resources, a company spokeswoman said.
